description: Summarize a URL, raw text or HTML at the length you request - short, medium or long - with the source noted. Neutral and factual, no invented facts. Try GET /summarize/sample. Part of the AgentIndex content kit (pdf, web-read, extract, summarize, detect-language) - see GET /capabilities.

html.description: Raw HTML to summarize. Provide exactly one of url, text or html.

text.description: Raw text to summarize. Provide exactly one of url, text or html.

url.description: URL to fetch and summarize. Provide exactly one of url, text or html.
